question.text: At least one team member of the Investment Manager of a Cat III AIF must obtain which certification?

answer.text: NISM-Series XIX-C (AIF Managers) or Series XIX-E (Cat III AIF Managers)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.1.4, one team member must hold the NISM-Series XIX-C or XIX-E certification. The Trap: V-A/X-A/XV are unrelated certifications for different roles. Cross-Exam Context: Cross-exam reference to XIX-C and XIX-E.
